children: Imports to the United States rose 2.8% month-over-month to $399.3 billion in July 2026, the largest since a record of $416.35 billion in March 2025.

Purchases rose for computers ($6.9 billion), computer accessories ($6.6 billion) and semiconductors ($1.2 billion) while a fall was seen for crude oil ($-1.8 billion) and charges for the use of intellectual property ($-0.5 billion).
Imports came mostly from Mexico ($60 billion), the European Union ($45.4 billion), Canada ($25.6 billion) and China ($25.6 billion).

title: US Imports Rise in July
